terms.comment: Here benignē is a polite refusal.

phrases.latin: Vēscere, sōdēs. — Jam satis est. — At tū, quantum vīs, tolle. — Benignē.
phrases.english: Eat, please. — I’ve had enough. — Take as much as you like. — No, thank you
Go home full, the evening star is coming (said after the meal)

sources: Lewis & Short: benigne · Lewis & Short: vescor
These are quotations, and their sources are given. Libellī II and IV and the back-matter lists of “locī memoriā tenendī” suggest when to use them with Theo.
